## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added / updated. Run `cargo test --all-features` locally first.
- [ ] `cargo fmt` and `cargo clippy --all-features -- -D warnings` pass.
- [ ] Line coverage ≥ 95% (run `cargo llvm-cov --all-features --workspace`).
- [ ] Documentation updated if public APIs changed.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]`.
- [ ] No `unsafe` blocks or `unwrap()` in production paths.
- [ ] Commit message follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
